title: panoma
settings.title: Settings
gestures.fingers.description: How many fingers swipe Panoma open and closed, and between workspaces inside it.
gestures.follow.description: The overview moves with your fingers as you swipe. Off: a swipe just opens or closes it.
gestures.distance.description: How far the fingers travel for a full open. Shorter is more sensitive.
gestures.invert.description: Swipe right instead of left to go to the next workspace.
look.speed.description: Turning animations off in Omarchy still turns these off too.
show.strip.description: Workspaces along the top: click to switch, drop a window to move it.
show.dock.description: Running apps along the bottom edge.
show.hints.description: The shortcuts at the top right.
show.badges.description: The number (or workspace) in the corner of each window.
keys.open.description: Hyprland shortcut. Click, then press the combination.
keys.send.description: This modifier + 1–9 moves the selected window.
keys.invalid.combo: Needs a modifier (Super, Ctrl, Alt) and a key, or a function key.
keys.invalid.key: One character that isn't a number, a space or h/j/k/l.
hypr.missing: Hyprland isn't loading Panoma's shortcuts yet: add pcall(require, "hypr.panoma") to ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua.
hypr.error: Hyprland rejected the change, so it was undone: %1
